title: Mangchi live at Viva! Pomona
editorial_title: Mangchi at Viva Pomona: backstage, symbols, and live performance
summary: A 6:09 mixed backstage, artwork and live-performance source. Mangchi introduces itself, describes a new EP on Bandcamp as K-core/Korean hardcore, leaves the damaged EP title unresolved, and discusses a favorite song whose title/meaning remain uncertain. A bodily stage-etiquette joke, pre-show excitement and doubt, live music, invented protect/destroy symbols, a therapeutic-feeling personal reaction, applause and a repeated art/action reaction exchange all remain. Unreliable lyric-looking tokens are preserved as timestamped performance events rather than fabricated lyrics. No idea is censored and no voice is named.

speaker_policy.status: multiple unidentified backstage/performance participants; names withheld
speaker_policy.reason: Title establishes Mangchi/Viva Pomona context but captions do not prefix speakers and no held-out acoustic validation exists.

Making/marking is described as the best part, therapeutic-feeling and nice.
Invented marks are described as protecting and destroying.
Caption fragments are insufficient for lyrics and remain events.
Repeated action prompts elicit love, stronger love and one negative reaction.
